summary: This class models the Accessibility flow for HP rebranding on Windows platform. It provides comprehensive UI automation methods for interacting with Windows OS elements including Start menu, taskbar, Microsoft Store, and HP application icons. The class focuses on verifying app installation, pinning status, and accessibility features. Key patterns include wait-for-object strategies, toggle state verification, and conditional element interaction. The class extends HPXRebrandingFlow and is designed to test Windows desktop application accessibility and user interface interactions for HP branded applications.
